---
title: "21_Opal"
subtitle: "Multiplex immunofluorescence: MUC5B+ epithelium and CD66b+ neutrophils in ECLE vs SE (Figure 8b, 8e)"
author: "Luca Mastrantoni"
output: html_document
---

Input: `DATA_INPUT/opal/ROI_Compositions_public.xlsx` (per-sample cell counts from the QuPath phenotyping: median of three ROIs per sample; ROI = patient code)
Output: Figure8b, 8e in `OUTPUT/FIGURES/Main/Figure8` and `OUTPUT/Excel Files/Main/Figure8`

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
source("Setup.R")
```

```{r}
opal <- read_xlsx(file.path(path_input, "opal", "ROI_Compositions_public.xlsx")) |>
  dplyr::rename(PanCK_MUC5B = `PanCK+/MUC5B+`,
                PanCK_MUC5Bn = `PanCK+/MUC5B-`,
                ARG = `CD66b+/MPO+/ARG+`,
                CD66_prop = `CD66b+_Prop`)

t.test(PanCK_MUC5B ~ Category, opal)
t.test(PanCK_MUC5Bn ~ Category, opal)

opal$Category <- in_order(opal$Category, Category_abbr)   # SE, then ECLE (after the tests: same sign as before)
```

```{r}
# Mean +/- SE bar per category with one dot per sample
opal_barplot <- function(y, y_label) {
  ggbarplot(opal, x = "Category", y = y, add = "mean_se", color = "black", fill = "Category",
            position = position_dodge(1)) +
    ggbeeswarm::geom_beeswarm(aes(x = Category, y = .data[[y]]), dodge.width = 0, cex = 4, size = 4,
                              shape = 21, fill = "darkgray", color = "black", alpha = 0.8) +
    labs(y = y_label, x = "") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = Category_abbr) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}
```

##### Figure 8b
```{r, fig.width = 4.8, fig.height = 2.88}
Figure8b <- opal_barplot("PanCK_MUC5B", "# PanCK+/MUC5B+ cells") +
  opal_barplot("PanCK_MUC5Bn", "# PanCK+/MUC5B- cells") +
  opal_barplot("MUC5B_Prop", "Proportion PanCK+/MUC5B+")
Figure8b

save_plot(Figure8b, "Figure8b.svg", width = 4.8, height = 2.88)   # as tall as panel a on the page
save_source_data(dplyr::select(opal, Patient = ROI, Category, `PanCK+/MUC5B+` = PanCK_MUC5B, `PanCK+/MUC5B-` = PanCK_MUC5Bn,
                               PANCK, MUC5B_Prop),
                 "Figure8b")
```

##### Figure 8e
```{r, fig.width = 1.95, fig.height = 4.75}
# two-line axis titles: the plots are short
Figure8e <- opal_barplot("CD66_prop", "Proportion\nCD66b+/MPO+") /
  opal_barplot("ARG", "# CD66b+/MPO+/\nARG1+")
Figure8e

save_plot(Figure8e, "Figure8e.svg", width = 1.95, height = 4.75)   # from the c-d letter line to the bottom of their legends
save_source_data(dplyr::select(opal, Patient = ROI, Category, `CD66b+_Combined`, Non_PANCK, `CD66b+_Prop` = CD66_prop,
                               `CD66b+/MPO+/ARG+` = ARG),
                 "Figure8e")
```
